name: Kampus INSTIKI
title: Kampus INSTIKI
descriptionId: Selamat datang di Kampus INSTIKI, Institut Bisnis dan Teknologi Indonesia. Perguruan tinggi swasta ini mengembangkan pendidikan di bidang bisnis dan teknologi untuk mempersiapkan mahasiswa menghadapi dunia industri dan ekonomi digital. Di titik ini, Anda dapat menjelajahi pengalaman augmented reality sambil mengenal kampus INSTIKI.
descriptionEn: Welcome to the INSTIKI campus, Institut Bisnis dan Teknologi Indonesia (Indonesia Institute of Business and Technology). This private higher education institution provides education in business and technology to prepare students for industry and the digital economy. At this location, you can explore an augmented reality experience while getting to know the INSTIKI campus.
